decisions.rationale: Verified at f18bccaf. Loop 1 (for the second half of C2E-NULL-05, the untaught no-ELSE fact) appended to the 'o3 no ELSE' stem in sql-jdbc-foundations/crud-aggregates-and-joins/handling-nulls-coalesce-and-case/artifact.gift: "(When ELSE is left out, PostgreSQL behaves as if ELSE NULL had been written.)". That parenthesis states the keyed answer '=NULL', so the item tests nothing. The fact itself is true per the cited 9.19.1 CASE documentation. Remedy (a), REVERT: restore the 8a7daa17 stem without the parenthesis. This REOPENS the second half of C2E-NULL-05 (low): the item tests a fact the page's Activity 3 teaching still does not state. I checked the f18bccaf body: there is no 'without ELSE' or 'ELSE NULL' sentence. Record it as open for a later loop (add the sentence to Activity 3 teaching within the word limit, or move the context into the correct option's feedback). Remedy (b), leave, is rejected: an item answered in its own stem is worse than a formative item that asks for an untaught fact and explains it in feedback.

Verified at f18bccaf. Loop 1 (for the first half of C2E-NULL-05, '!=' untaught) replaced the distractor '~phone !\= NULL' in 'o1 present values' with '~NOT (phone \= NULL)', which already appears as another option. The four-option item now has two identical distractors and only three distinct choices, and it no longer practises the not-equal-with-NULL misconception. Remedy (a), REVERT: restore the 8a7daa17 distractor '~phone !\= NULL#Not quite. Any comparison with NULL, including !\=, is unknown for every row, so WHERE keeps no members at all.' This REOPENS the first half of C2E-NULL-05 (low): '!=' is not taught on any learner page of the module (checked at f18bccaf; it appears only in adapter code). The feedback does name it as a comparison, and the cited 9.2 documentation calls != an alias of <>. Record it as open for a later loop (use <> in the distractor, or teach != as an alias). Remedy (b), leave, is rejected: a duplicated option is a broken item.
